options.content: ● normal  ● warning  ● alarm  ● data problem  ·  ⌀ 30-day avg  ·  yesterday = from this morning's readings  ·  ⓘ details  ·  New dashboard for review: limits not yet set, so values show in white

panels.description: Treated outflow yesterday. Design 100,000 m³/day. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; until the daily statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char((SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL), 'DD Mon') AS "Day", daily_flow_out AS "Yesterday", 100 * daily_flow_out / 100000 AS "% of design" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Treated outflow

panels.description: Plant energy yesterday. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; until the daily statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT daily_power_total AS "Yesterday" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Power

panels.description: Energy ÷ treated outflow. Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; until the daily statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT daily_power_total / NULLIF(daily_flow_out, 0) AS "Yesterday", (SELECT avg(daily_power_total / NULLIF(daily_flow_out, 0)) FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" BETWEEN ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) - 29 AND ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: Specific energy

panels.description: Inlet to outlet COD removed. Target ≥ 80 % (existing lab dashboard). Shows the latest day with statistics (normally yesterday; until the daily statistics run, the day before).

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100 * (daily_avg_inlet_cod - daily_avg_outlet_cod) / NULLIF(daily_avg_inlet_cod, 0) AS "Yesterday" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" = (SELECT max("Date") FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) AND daily_flow_out IS NOT NULL)

panels.title: COD reduction

panels.description: Core forms with a reading dated yesterday: flow, power, lab.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 25) AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_powermeterreadingdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 25) AND (datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_labtestdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 25) AND (time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date = ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "of 3"

panels.title: Readings entered

panels.description: Latest lab COD at each stage (yesterday, or the latest sample within 3 days). Stage targets from the existing lab dashboard: primary ≥ 20 %, secondary ≥ 70 %.

targets.rawSql: WITH l AS (SELECT btrim(location) AS loc, btrim(type_of_lab_test) AS test, result, (time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day FROM user_labtestdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 25) AND time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '6 days'), ld AS (SELECT loc, test, max(day) AS day FROM l WHERE day <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) GROUP BY loc, test) SELECT (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Inlet' AND l.test = 'COD') AS "Inlet COD", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'PC%' AND l.test = 'COD') AS "Primary COD", 100 * (1 - (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'PC%' AND l.test = 'COD') / NULLIF((SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Inlet' AND l.test = 'COD'), 0)) AS "Primary reduction", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'CFI%-ClarifierOut' AND l.test = 'COD') AS "Biological COD", 100 * (1 - (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'CFI%-ClarifierOut' AND l.test = 'COD') / NULLIF((SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'PC%' AND l.test = 'COD'), 0)) AS "Secondary reduction"

panels.title: Treatment stages · COD

panels.description: Latest DO (mg/L), MLSS (mg/L) and SV30 (mL/L) per unit.

'SV30')::numeric)), '') AS "CFI 3", NULLIF(concat_ws(' · ', 'DO ' || round((SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE panels.title: Biological units

panels.description: Latest outlet lab results. Limits: COD 225/250, TSS 80/100, ammonia (TAN) 40/50 mg/L (existing NTIEM lab dashboard); pH 6.5–8.5 (same as AHSPA). No limits for TDS and temperature.

targets.rawSql: WITH l AS (SELECT btrim(location) AS loc, btrim(type_of_lab_test) AS test, result, (time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date AS day FROM user_labtestdata WHERE form_id IN (SELECT id FROM user_customform WHERE team_id = 25) AND time_of_sample_collection > now() - interval '6 days'), ld AS (SELECT loc, test, max(day) AS day FROM l WHERE day <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) GROUP BY loc, test) SELECT (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'COD') AS "COD", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'TSS') AS "TSS", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'pH') AS "pH", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'TAN') AS "Ammonia (TAN)", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'TDS') AS "TDS", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'Colour') AS "Colour", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'Turbidity') AS "Turbidity", (SELECT avg(l.result) FROM l JOIN ld ON ld.loc = l.loc AND ld.test = l.test AND ld.day = l.day WHERE l.loc ILIKE 'Outlet' AND l.test = 'Temperature') AS "Temperature"

panels.title: Outlet quality

targets.rawSql: SELECT ("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, daily_flow_out AS "Outflow" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE $__timeFilter("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AND "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, 100 * (daily_avg_inlet_cod - daily_avg_outlet_cod) / NULLIF(daily_avg_inlet_cod, 0) AS "COD reduction" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE $__timeFilter("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AND "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS time, daily_avg_outlet_cod AS "Outlet COD" FROM gsi_ntiem_stats WHERE $__timeFilter("Date"::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AND "Date" <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date - 1) ORDER BY 1
